itemized.notes: Page-face candidate 'Larry Alton Ellertson' (verification block the same), Republican, Office Seeking written 'Utah County Commission Seat C', residence city Lindon UT. index.csv names NO candidate for this row (channel label 'Ellertson - 10/29/12'), so the page face supplies the name and it agrees with index.csv's office. 4 pages on the 2012 legacy_colAB blank characterised on key 9630b1c7: p1 COVER, p2 SUMMARY PAGE, p3 SCHEDULE A, p4 SCHEDULE B - each classified from its own printed header, the summary page located by its heading and not by ordinal. Report type 'Seven days preceding the General Election' ticked; amendment 'No' ticked; signed 10-29-12; clerk stamp OCT 29 AM 7:09. Foliation 2/3/4 'of 4', INCLUDING the cover, consistent with this filer's June report and opposite to Ballard's practice in the same cycle. A WRITING-CONVENTION SHIFT WITHIN ONE FILER'S CYCLE: on his June report this filer wrote no thousands separators anywhere; here he writes '7,300.00', '16,224.31', '1,000.00' etc. with commas on the summary page and on most - not all - schedule rows. Recorded because it is exactly the kind of within-filer variation that makes a fixed-format parser fail on this corpus. BOTH SIDES CLOSE EXACTLY on the promoted per-period Column A figure and on each schedule's own printed subtotal and total. COVER-CHAIN OBSERVATION ONLY, never a source of figures: this filing's line 3 beginning balance (7,429.98) is character-for-character the line 7 close of his own June filing, and its Column B cumulatives are the two June per-period figures plus these two (8,924.31 + 7,300.00 = 16,224.31; 9,759.51 + 6,160.85 = 15,920.36). The chain is internally consistent - noted as a property of the record, not used to derive or adjust any figure here. PRIVACY: this era is unredacted (ADDENDUM A5); full donor street lines and one post-office box are visible on Schedule A and none is carried into this record, in any field or note.
